answer: One tide counter tracks clones per funding root: the k-th cloned identity posts k times 250 POA in escrow, so total bond rises quadratic and one hundred fakes pay 25,000 POA for the weight of one honest vote. Each fresh key needs two vouchers whose bonded deposits burn together when any clone misbehaves, and the quill ledger records every funding root before its seal counts. Honest work stays cheap: one honest voyage of 40 verified epochs costs 1,000 POA, while the attacker's tenth identity costs more than his whole cluster earns back.
